bill_text.text_with_changes:
A bill for an act relating to education; requiring notice of procedural safeguards for special education; proposing coding for new law in Minnesota Statutes, chapter 125A.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1.

[+[125A.421] NOTICE OF PROCEDURAL SAFEGUARDS; TRANSLATION. +]

[+The Department of Education must develop and maintain an oral translation of the notice for procedural safeguards provided to a parent or guardian of a child with a disability. +]

[+EFFECTIVE DATE.+]

[+This section is effective for the 2026-2027 school year and later. +]
bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to education; requiring notice of procedural safeguards for special education; proposing coding for new law in Minnesota Statutes, chapter 125A.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1.

[125A.421] NOTICE OF PROCEDURAL SAFEGUARDS; TRANSLATION.

The Department of Education must develop and maintain an oral translation of the notice for procedural safeguards provided to a parent or guardian of a child with a disability.

EFFECTIVE DATE.

This section is effective for the 2026-2027 school year and later.
additions: The Department of Education must develop and maintain an oral translation of the notice for procedural safeguards provided to a parent or guardian of a child with a disability.
This section is effective for the 2026-2027 school year and later.
